VeraGridEngine.DataStructures.bus_data.propagate_controls(chosen_idx: int, other_idx: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[int64]], bus_types: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[int64]], Vbus: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], is_p_controlled: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[bool]], is_q_controlled: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[bool]], is_vm_controlled: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[bool]], is_va_controlled: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[bool]]) → None[source]

Propagate the strongest control status of a reduced bus cluster to the surviving bus.

The donor bus is chosen from chosen_idx and other_idx using the actual control flags, not only the bus type, so VSC/HVDC-added controls are preserved as well. :param chosen_idx: island of the island chosen by the topological reduction process to represent the reduction set :param other_idx: rest of buses in the set that are going to be reduced but may contain important information :param bus_types: :param Vbus: :param is_p_controlled: :param is_q_controlled: :param is_vm_controlled: :param is_va_controlled: :return:

VeraGridEngine.DataStructures.numerical_circuit.select_ac_phase_reference_buses(bus_types: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[int64]], active_power: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[float64]], bus_active: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[bool]], is_dc_bus: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[bool]], branch_from: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[int64]], branch_to: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[int64]], branch_active: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[bool]]) → ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[int64]][source]

Select missing angular references in independent AC phase regions.

Passive AC branches couple voltage angles. VSC and DC connections transfer power without coupling the absolute AC phase, so they must not merge the regions used to select one reference bus.

Parameters:

  • bus_types – Compiled bus modes before automatic promotion.

  • active_power – Active-power injections used to rank PV candidates.

  • bus_active – Active state of every bus.

  • is_dc_bus – DC classification of every bus.

  • branch_from – From-bus indices of passive branches.

  • branch_to – To-bus indices of passive branches.

  • branch_active – Active state of passive branches.

Returns:

PV bus indices that must become angular references.
